audit.why: EVEN 5.5/10 fits 52.19% over 2964 games. The difficulty is not flat across the game: Katarina holds levels 1 through first item because Parallel Convergence telegraphs for three seconds and Phase Dive is only 325 range, and loses the 2+ item duel because Chronobreak re-rolls it.
audit.corrected: Label unchanged; the chart now shows the single flip instead of reading 'Skill' seven times.

audit.whatIsWrong: All seven full-layer sides read 'Skill'; the content layer and the packet both read Katarina on six rows and Ekko at 2+ items.
audit.why: Chronobreak at 110s rank 1 down to 50s rank 3 is the whole curve of this matchup — early it is a one-per-two-waves escape you can force with a half-commit, late it is a duel re-roll on a short cooldown. That is why exactly one row flips.
audit.corrected: phases[0..5].side -> Katarina, phases[6].side -> Ekko, ratings moved with them, and phases[6].why rewritten in the same proposal because its verdict flipped. win[0..6] already holds these values on disk.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit; dosFull[1].d was tradeGood pasted under 'Blink to daggers, not targets'; dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad pasted under 'Fight away from your steel'; and dosFull[2].d invented a 'fifteen-second invitation' when Chronobreak is 110/80/50.
audit.why: The interaction that actually kills Katarina here is Parallel Convergence: Ekko entering his own anomaly gains a shield AND stuns everyone inside, and Katarina's R is flagged channel-interruptible, so that stun ends Death Lotus. The second one, absent from the page entirely, is that Phase Dive is an auto-attack reset — his combo opens on a charge-up, so the wind-up is the tell, not the cast.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now carries R 110/80, W 22s with its three-second tell and E 9s at 325 range; the stun-ends-channel rule is in tradeBad and dontsFull[2].d; the auto-reset tell is in dosFull[1].d and report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no number, and two other fields carried numbers that do not exist in his kit: 'fifteen-second invitation' in dosFull[2].d, and '100+ seconds' for a forced Chronobreak in whys[5] and spikes[2].text.
audit.why: Chronobreak is 110/80/50. '100+ seconds' is only true at rank 1; by the first-item timing the field describes, it is usually 80s. Directionally right is not right, and a reader who plans two waves off a wrong number gets caught.
audit.corrected: '100+ seconds' -> '80-110 seconds' in both content fields; 'fifteen-second invitation' -> '110 seconds at rank 1'.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.wave used the placeholder 'a CC mage's tower'.
audit.why: The concrete wave trap is a freeze near his tower where the W anomaly can arm on top of the dagger you must walk onto to reset.
audit.corrected: Rewritten around his slower pre-3 clear and the anomaly-on-your-dagger trap.

audit.whatIsWrong: The brief's missingInteractions offers two rules; one is good and one is false. 'Ekko's combo opens with an auto-attack reset (Phase Dive)' is supported by Riot's text and the autoReset flag. 'Your Bouncing Blade (Q) shuts off Ekko's Phase Dive' is not.
audit.why: Katarina's Q grounding flag contradicts Riot's description of the ability, which is a thrown dagger that bounces and ricochets to the ground. This is the third brief in this slice carrying that same bad flag.
audit.corrected: The auto-reset tell is written into dosFull[1].d and report[5].t. The grounding claim is not written anywhere.
